component.name: AI Agents
component.summary: Launch AI coding agents and watch their token usage

description.p: A panel applet for AI coding agents. Launch an agent in any project directory, see which ones are running, and watch what they are costing you, without leaving the panel.

ul.li: Today's and this week's usage as a percentage of your budget, today's token count, a 14 day bar chart and a rolling five hour gauge.
Every agent process you own, with its working directory and uptime.
One launch tile per agent CLI found on your PATH, plus a picker for the directory to start it in.

description.p: Usage is read from the local Claude Code transcripts and priced with an editable table. The figures estimate what the same traffic would cost on the API; they are not a bill and they know nothing about subscription plans. The panel shows percentages rather than amounts, so a screenshot does not put your spend on display.
